note: World Series publish anomaly watcher (apps/observer/ops/ws_alert.py). Every threshold here is PROVISIONAL: copied from docs/pm/service/ws-operations-runbook.md section 3 or chosen for the watcher, none measured on a live game yet. Paths are never inside the repository; null = taken from env or CLI (see the runbook section 7).

paths.out_dir_note: Publisher output folder (the one holding v1/). null = --out or env PITCHEEZY_PUBLISH_OUT_DIR.
paths.state_path_note: Publisher state file. null = env PITCHEEZY_PUBLISH_STATE, else '<out_dir>.state.json' (the publisher's own default).
paths.ops_status_note: Operations status file (interface in the runbook section 7.3). null = --ops-status or env PITCHEEZY_WS_OPS_STATUS; absent = not read.
paths.alert_dir_note: Watcher state (alert_state.json) and the append-only alerts.jsonl. Env PITCHEEZY_ALERT_DIR or --alert-dir overrides.
paths.disk_paths_note: Free space is checked on each of these and on the output folder's parent.

game_window.note: A game is 'in window' from start-before_start_s until it is final, or at most start+max_game_s. Sources: the publisher's games/<KST date>.json (yesterday..tomorrow), the ops status file, and schedule below.

schedule_note: Manual fallback when the publisher has not listed the game: [{"game_pk": 123, "start": "2026-10-24T00:08:00Z"}].
thresholds_note: Runbook section 3: health stall 30 s (3 cycles), feed_ok false > 60 s, lag > 45 s, pending > 0 beyond 3 cycles, blocked at once, disk floor 12.5 GiB (the refresh skips near 12 GiB), profile ok by 21:20 KST. Watcher-only choices: publisher_down 120 s, file_stuck 300 s (a live game normally changes within a few minutes; between-inning breaks are about 2-3 minutes), memory 2 GiB from vm_stat free+inactive+speculative (an approximation, not the memory pressure colour).

notify.note: A condition notifies once when it starts (after its hold), again every renotify_s while it lasts (renotify_outside_game_s when no game is in window), and once when it clears. After clearing, the same key does not notify again for cooldown_s (flapping).

game_gated_note: Families evaluated only while a game is in window (quiet otherwise). Always on: upload_blocked / upload_conflict / upload_unknown (they never clear by themselves), state_unreadable, disk_low, profile_refresh, ops_problem, watch_config.
